body: pix2tex: Using a ViT to convert images of equations into LaTeX code.
plain_description: **Turn images of math formulas into LaTeX code.** Use the command line, Python, or a graphical interface to convert screenshots and image files. Copy the recognized code to your clipboard from the GUI.
technical_description: pix2tex uses a learning based system with a ViT encoder, ResNet backbone, and Transformer decoder to convert images of mathematical formulas into LaTeX. It can be used through a command line tool, Python package, GUI, or an API with a Streamlit demo. The README also describes training the model with paired formula images and LaTeX labels.
title: pix2tex
